title: Operator action assertions and minimal delta payload
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Background: As part of RBAC v2 rollout we need a compact, operator-focused audit payload that captures what changed, who initiated it, and enough context to support post-hoc replay, policy debugging, and alerting without leaking PII. Goal: define an event taxonomy and minimal delta/patch encoding for administrator-initiated operations and automated policy changes (canary rollouts, role inheritance updates). Non-goals: this ticket does not fully specify storage/retention tiers or the streaming transport (Kafka/HTTP) — those are separate tasks. Proposed approach: 1) Produce a single audit event envelope with stable header fields (event_id, timestamp, request_id, source) and a small typed payload describing the action. 2) For state changes, embed a compact delta payload using a typed patchset encoding optimized for common admin operations (role add/remove, permission flip, principal-binding change). 3) Include actor assertions (identity, auth_method, confidence, sso_assertion_reference) and optional actor_hints to aid fuzzy matching across identity providers. 4) Canonicalize target resources (resource_type, resource_id, path) and record target ancestry where useful. 5) Provide guidelines for redaction (tokenization of emails/SSNs), sampling, and when to emit full snapshots vs minimal deltas. Key schema fields (human-readable list): event_id, timestamp, request_id, origin (console|api|infra), actor_id, actor_display, actor_type (user|service|automation), auth_method (sso|apikey|oauth), actor_confidence_score, sso_issuer, sso_assertion_ref, session_id, target_type, target_id, target_path, action, action_category, before_digest, after_digest, patchset (compact ops list), change_summary, visibility (public|internal|restricted), customer_id (if applicable), correlation_keys, risk_flags, sampling_hint, retention_tier, storage_location_hint, schema_version. Encoding notes: patchset should be a compact array of typed ops (op, path, old_hash, new_hash) with a max inline size; for large objects provide a snapshot_url and content-hash. Use canonical attribute names and stable hashing (sha256) for 'before_digest' and 'after_digest' to support diffs without payload leaks. Backward compatibility: schema must include schema_version and backwards-compatibility rules; new fields MUST be optional. Privacy: default to removing raw user emails in actor_display unless customer opted in; use actor_hints to store opaque identity mappings for operator debugging. This ticket covers the spec, a reference encoder/decoder (Go), and a set of unit tests and fixtures for common admin flows.
acceptance_criteria: Spec document drafted and reviewed by Security + Platform
Reference encoder/decoder implemented (Go) with round-trip tests
Unit tests demonstrating compact patchset encoding for 5 common admin actions
Example events produced for console changes, SAML role mappings, and automated role rollouts
Backward compatibility guidelines written and added to schema doc
Security review completed and redaction guidelines approved
comments: 2025-02-18 | Maya Thompson: Initial ticket created. Attached rough encoding notes and example patchset patterns. Marking as P1 because this underpins several compliance requirements.
2025-02-19 | Diego Alvarez: Proposed trade-off — keep patchset ops minimal (add/remove/replace/hash-swap). Avoid full json-patches to limit size and attacker surface. Will prototype toy encoder.

2025-02-20 | Priya Menon (Security): Please add explicit guidance on SSO assertion references vs full assertion. We should never persist raw SAML assertions; only store stable reference IDs and issuer metadata. Also recommend actor_confidence score (0-100) when SSO->RBAC mapping is heuristic.

2025-02-21 | Diego Alvarez: Implemented initial Go encoder prototype and pushed fixtures to GH branch. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pulls/4123 (WIP). Added three example events in /docs/samples/minimal-deltas.md.

2025-02-24 | Design review (Aisha Patel): suggested clearer UX mapping for console — include human-friendly change_summary in addition to machine patchset so auditors can read events in the Console UI.
2025-02-25 | Compliance (Liam Chen): flagged retention_tier and customer_scoped flags — need to include opt-out/obfuscation controls for enterprise customers. Marked security_review_required.
